source: lab (Orbbec Femto Mega RGB, background replaced with green by Segment Anything 2; watermark bottom-right)

camera.motion: static (phase correlation vs frame 0: |shift| <= 0.13 px in all frames)
camera.perspective: camera slightly above table height looking at a square table seen obliquely; table top corners approx back-left (455,450), back-right (915,465), front-left (210,540), front-right (1140,590); image y increases toward the camera on the table plane

ball.desc: white ball (ping-pong-like) - the only moving object. Starts at rest on the far-left corner of the table top, launched rightwards along the table, rolls in front of the card tent / flat cards and the white cup, still rolling at the last frame
ball.reference_point: cx, cy = centre of the visible ball (mask bbox centre)

apparent_diameter_px.at_rest_frames_0_5: about 40-41 (bbox 43x41, left part clipped by segmentation artefact)
apparent_diameter_px.note: use height_px / max_col_height (vertical, blur-free); width_px includes horizontal motion blur (~53 px when moving)

ball.image_motion: left to right, x 277 -> 968 px, y 492 -> 511 px (slightly toward camera)

pink_bottle.desc: pink insulated bottle with cream lid, behind-left of card tent

white_cup.desc: white tumbler/cup right of bottle, right of card tent

card_tent.desc: two playing cards leaning against each other (card house) in front of the bottle

flat_cards.desc: playing card(s) lying flat on table in front of the card tent

dark_card.desc: dark blue card/phone with yellow sticker lying near the front edge of the table

table.desc: square wooden table top on a single black pedestal

events.event: ball at rest on far-left corner of table, centre ~(277, 492)
ball starts a small leftward shift (~3 px, frames 5-8) - pre-launch contact by the (segmented-out) striker
ball launched: first moving frame, step ~50 px, heavy motion blur (launch between frames 11 and 12)
per-frame step has fallen from ~50 (f12) via 31, 28, 24, 20 to ~16-17 px/frame; roughly steady ~16 px/frame afterwards
ball starts passing in front of the card tent and flat cards (not occluded; ball is in front)
ball passes in front of the white cup base (frames ~34-37)
step 35->36 is ~33 px (twice normal): probable dropped frame in the recording
last frame, ball still rolling at ~(968, 511), no impact or bounce in the clip
